acceptance.assertion: Remote and privileged effects are exposed only through named versioned action schemas with exact host, target, scope, timeout, recovery and evidence bindings.
An operator-bound PTY session supports bounded input, redacted output, liveness, cancellation, expiry and immutable closeout receipts without treating pane state as authority.
A rootless execution cell provides explicit filesystem, network, process, resource and secret boundaries and fails closed when the requested isolation cannot be established.
Every executor reuses Captain authority gates, typed leases, blast-radius policy, kill switch and recovery contracts rather than creating a parallel authorization path.
The public action surface cannot dispatch caller-composed shell strings or silently widen a declared target into general host access.
Adversarial tests and live no-cost pilots cover transport loss, privilege denial, PTY disconnect, sandbox escape attempts, timeout, cancellation, replay and unclear outcomes.

approval.note: Implement only typed bounded executors. Preserve explicit authority, privacy, cost, recovery and kill-switch gates.

goal: Extend the Captain executor registry with typed remote and privileged operations, an operator-bound interactive session broker, and a rootless execution cell while keeping arbitrary shell, hidden privilege escalation and unbounded host access outside the contract.

metadata.reason: These three capabilities share one executor, authority, lease, recovery and audit boundary and should be delivered as one vertical slice rather than separate subsystems.

title: Add typed remote interactive execution cells
